create_multicrop_collator: create a multicrop collator that batches multi-crop image data for SwAV training approach
test_multicrop_collator: test the multicrop collator with a batch of samples containing data, labels, data_valid, and data_idx fields
build_multidimensional_tensor: build a MultiDimensionalTensor from stacked output tensors by setting create_multidimensional_tensor to True
review_multicrop_collator: review the multicrop collator function that reorganizes k-copies of images per sample into per-crop-position batches
summarize_multicrop_collator: summarize the multicrop collator that transforms per-sample multi-crop lists into per-crop-position stacked tensors
